text: Bitcoin briefly fell below $90,000, erasing its 2025 gains as investors exited speculative positions and AI-linked tech stocks declined in parallel.

meta.note: Speculative unwind exposes correlation inversion between crypto and major tech equities.

text: Home Depot cut its full-year profit outlook and missed earnings expectations for the third straight quarter due to weaker home improvement demand, elevated borrowing costs, and reduced storm-driven purchases.

meta.note: Deferral mindset continues to suppress large renovation projects; demand stabilization without acceleration indicates continuity without near-term catalysts.

text: Cloudflare resolved a global outage caused by an automatically generated configuration file that exceeded expected size and crashed traffic-handling services, temporarily disrupting access to major platforms including X, ChatGPT, Claude, Shopify and others.

meta.note: Single-point infra dependency surfaced; continuity restored but scaling boundary exposure remains instructive.

text: Microsoft and Nvidia announced major strategic partnerships with Anthropic, including up to $5B from Microsoft and up to $10B from Nvidia, pushing Anthropic’s valuation to roughly $350B. Anthropic committed to purchasing $30B in Azure compute and up to 1 GW of capacity from both Azure and Nvidia’s Grace Blackwell and Rubin systems.

meta.note: Cross-capital and compute alignment; Microsoft executes second-pass diversification beyond OpenAI; infrastructure-level bridge formation.
